The Rotation in Tape setting must be interpreted relative to the tape's orientation,
regardless of how the feeder/tape is oriented on the machine.

  1. Look at the neutral upright orientation of the part package/footprint
    as drawn inside your E-CAD library.

  2. Note how pin 1, polarity, cathode etc. are oriented.
    This is your 0° for the part.

  3. Look at the tape so that the sprocket holes are at the top.
    This is your 0° tape orientation (per EIA-481 industry standard).

  4. Determine how the part is rotated inside the tape pocket, relative from
    its upright orientation in (1). Positive rotation goes counter-clockwise.
    This is your Rotation in Tape.
